# Draft:The Queen of Akra

The Queen of Akra is a Ghanian movie Directed by William Kojo Agbeti and was written by David Nii Amarh. It was released on 6th March, 2024. A new biopic about Naa Dode Akabi, the first female king of the Ga kingdom, will premiere on March 6. The film stars DWP Academy's rising talent, Melissa Nortey, in the lead role, and many academy members and fans have been praising her on social media.
Cast.
* Melissa Nortey
* Ad Gladys
* Faiba Bernard
